purpose: Predeclare the minimum one-factor-at-a-time Sample A/B candidate matrix before either sample is fitted.

pseudo_voigt_shared_eta.eta_scope: one fitted eta shared by every peak in one regional fit
pseudo_voigt_shared_eta.status: requires implementation and unit tests before A/B fitting

center_wide.definition: For each peak, subtract 0.25 eV from the current lower center bound and add 0.25 eV to the current upper center bound, limited only by the retained fitting window.

fwhm_wide.definition: For each peak, widen each side of the current FWHM interval by 25% of its current span while retaining a strictly positive lower bound.

unresolved_bound_decision.mentor_question: Should a separately and chemically justified center-bound candidate containing approximately 287.3 eV be added before freeze?

draws.center_eV: U(max(lower, nominal-0.20), min(upper, nominal+0.20)); sample directly from the intersection, never clip

initialization_stability_probe.selection_rule: The starts are a stability diagnostic. A lower residual from an isolated chemically different basin is not evidence for selecting that basin.

energy_calibration.E1_eligibility: Use only a documented acquisition correction or an independent calibration feature not chosen from the F1s semi-covalent peak and not chosen to improve published fluorination agreement.
energy_calibration.apply_to: All applicable regional energy axes from the same acquisition context, with raw and corrected centers both retained.
energy_calibration.when_no_independent_reference_exists: Retain E0, report absolute-position uncertainty, and withhold position-qualified Model 2.

conditional_F1s_component_probes.chemical_hypothesis: substrate or metal-associated fluorine distinct from the locked component

probe_execution_trigger: The retained energy window covers the proposed component and both flanks.
The base-candidate residual has a reproducible signed feature spanning at least three adjacent points.
Feature amplitude is at least three times a truth-blind robust residual scale estimate declared before fitting.
The location has an independent chemical assignment; no component is added solely to improve a published composition value.
Within the same background, shape, window, and likelihood, delta BIC is <= -10 and delta AICc is <= -6 relative to the corresponding base candidate.
bootstrap_support_test: At least 450 of 500 bootstrap replicates are valid.
The fitted-area 95% interval has a lower endpoint greater than zero.
The component center and chemical label remain consistent with the proposed assignment.

hierarchy: stable-basin start count, with 5/5 preferred to 4/5
residual-structure class and common-domain NRMSE/lag-1 autocorrelation
bootstrap valid rate and interval-width identifiability
cross_background_selection.practically_indistinguishable: Same Tier-1 status and stable-start count; same residual class; NRMSE within 5% relative and absolute lag-1 correlation within 0.05; equal exact-bound count and near-bound count difference below two; paired changes inside all stability limits; bootstrap valid rate within 5 percentage points; every applicable interval width within 10% relative.

bootstrap_uncertainty_scope.included: Conditional empirical fit/model uncertainty under the selected peak, background, residual resampling, window, and bounds.

explicit_exclusions: No Cartesian crossing of shape, background, and bound variants.
No tightened-bound candidate: Phase 0H did not support one and recurring bound sensitivity makes tightening prior-dominated.
No combined center-and-FWHM widening: the corresponding severe-overlap Phase 0H probe was catastrophic and included the sole scientific nonconvergence.
No candidate ranking using published Sample A/B fluorination values.
